Who we are

Brightside Bookkeeping Ltd. ("we") provides bookkeeping services to small businesses.

What we collect

  • Contact details you give us.
  • Financial records you share for bookkeeping.
  • Basic analytics about how our website is used.

How we use it

Only to provide our services, meet legal obligations and, with your consent, send our newsletter.

Retention

We keep financial records for seven years, as required by law.

Your rights

You can ask for a copy of your data or ask us to delete it. Email privacy@brightside.example.
